svg.title: Admission decision for a proposed legacy PCM input bridge
svg.desc: A legacy live source has no o2at credit interface. A transparent bridge needs a qualified framing path and a real coherent clock relationship. Otherwise an explicit separate rate-conversion path or rejection is required; future ADAT and source-clock tracking remain conditional.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

color: rgb(81, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Proposed legacy PCM bridge: S/P-DIF or future ADAT

div.style: color: rgb(22, 61, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Supported framing and channel map qualified?

div.style: color: rgb(84, 32, 28) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Reject the unsupported input or profile

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Can the actual live-source clock be coherent with the receiver?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Establish and verify the real audio-frequency relationship

div.style: color: rgb(22, 61, 37) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Explicit rate-conversion path selected and qualified?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Use that separately specified conversion path

div.style: color: rgb(84, 32, 28) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Apply o2at format, capacity and cumulative-credit admission

div.style: color: rgb(81, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Future ADAT needs a bridge and channel map; source-clock tracking needs a specified estimator, servo and jitter transfer

div.style: color: rgb(81, 59, 20) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: Finite buffering and PAUSE cannot stop the original live stream
